about: Beställningssidan för figurer (/character i Darrowmere-panelen). Fälten är data: id är en punktad väg in i receptet, show_if döljer fält som inte gäller, adv lägger dem under Advanced. character_order.py läser samma fil för standardvärdena.

style.semi: semi-stylized realistic 3D game character render, natural human anatomy, not cartoon, not Pixar or Disney style, soft even lighting
style.stylized: stylized 3D game character render, hand-painted stylized PBR textures, soft even lighting

outfit.bodystocking: a seamless skin-tight matte grey full-body stocking from the neck down over arms, legs and feet, ending at the wrists, with no seams, edges or straps, like a second skin
outfit.underwear: skin-tight seamless matte grey underwear that follows the body like a second skin
outfit.swimsuit: a high-cut matte one-piece bathing suit

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Short id for the files (letters, digits, dashes), e.g. nora. Empty: taken from the subject.

fields.label: Title
fields.help: Shown in the job list and the gallery. Empty: made from the subject.

fields.label: Level
fields.help: Picks the tested settings for the time you have: fewer images and texture views when quick, more alternatives, view rings and texture bakes when best. Everything can still be changed below.

fields.label: Graphics card
fields.help: The runner's lane. First free card takes the first T1000 that is free. Each card runs one job at a time, all cards at once.

fields.label: Reference images
fields.help: One or more images. Give each a view: the front image drives Pixal3D and the texture; Tripo and Meshy also use back and side views. Pixal3D gets a copy scaled to 1024 px (larger input gave loose strands).

fields.label: Subject
fields.help: Who, short. It goes first in the prompt: Krea-2 follows the first words best (that is how bald finally worked).

fields.label: Creature type
fields.help: Animals and other creatures skip the human rules: bald, brows, head size pick, T-pose, face mirror and the clean face review. A four-legged animal is drawn in a three-quarter side view with all four legs visible.

fields.label: Bald (hair is a separate layer)
fields.help: Puts bald first in the subject and bans the word hair in prompt rewrites. Krea has no negative prompt: 'no hair' draws hair.

fields.label: No eyebrows or eyelashes
fields.help: The 3D models build lots of geometry for brows and lashes; they go on later as texture. Adds a review criterion and bans the words in rewrites. Krea still tends to draw them.

fields.label: Body
fields.help: Optional, e.g. slender legs, narrow hips, fairly full bust.

fields.label: Wearing
fields.help: Tight matte clothes give clean surfaces and show the body shape. Pixal3D builds every edge it sees (sysslingen's underwear became ridges), so base bodies wear a seamless body stocking; underwear goes on later as texture.

fields.label: Custom outfit
fields.help: Tight clothes give clean surfaces for the texture. Matte fabric: highlights get painted into the texture.

fields.label: Pose
fields.help: Symmetric poses make rigging and the face mirror work. T-pose needs a square frame or the hands get cut off.

fields.label: Images
fields.help: With two or more, every image is made first and the one with the most natural head size (measured, not guessed) is reviewed and goes on to the model; the rest stay in the gallery.

fields.label: Pick by head size
fields.help: Measures heads tall (figure height / head height) on each image's silhouette and picks the one closest to 7.6. Krea-2 drew Cassandra 6.96 heads tall, and Pixal3D made the skull too wide. Needs two or more images.

fields.label: Smallest heads tall
fields.help: If no image reaches this, the order stops before the 3D model instead of building a big-headed figure.

fields.label: Normal head and eyes
fields.help: Adult proportions, head about 1/7 of the height. Also a review criterion. Krea drew the cousin's head 20 % too wide.

fields.label: Space around the figure
fields.help: Asks for empty space around head, hands and feet. The cousin filled 98 % of the height and Pixal3D stretched the parts at the edges.

fields.label: Straight-on front view
fields.help: Body and face square to the camera. Without it Krea often turns the figure a little.

fields.label: Image size
fields.help: Pixal3D always gets 1024 px; larger images only help the texture.

fields.label: Final prompt (override)
fields.help: Empty: built from the fields above (shown in the plan). Anything here is sent to Krea-2 as is.

fields.label: Stop after the images
fields.help: Only draw and review. Pick a favourite in the gallery and order the model from it with My own reference images.

fields.label: AI review of the first image
fields.help: Claude Haiku checks the image against the rules and redraws it with a new seed when it fails.

fields.label: Clean face rule
fields.help: No jewellery, paint or markings on the face, round human ears. Bald and pose rules are added from the reference settings.

default: Exactly one character, shown whole from head to toe and centered, both hands and feet inside the frame.
Plain even background, no other objects or text; no strong white highlights on clothes or skin; correct hands and face.
fields.label: Criteria
fields.help: One per line. Soft criteria give a score; hard rules (from the toggles) fail the image outright.

fields.label: Repair the prompt on fail
fields.help: The reviewer rewrites the prompt from what went wrong.

fields.label: Words the rewrite may not use
fields.help: Comma separated. hair, hairstyle and haircut are added when Bald is on.

fields.label: Model
fields.help: Pixal3D gives a dense mesh of about 700 000 triangles from the front image. Tripo and Meshy can use several views.

fields.label: Game model
fields.help: A low-poly copy with colour and normal map baked from the dense model (Blender on Darrowmere).

fields.label: Quad mesh (experimental)
fields.help: Tries QuadriFlow quads (about half as many quads as triangles). QuadriFlow usually refuses AI meshes; you then get triangles and the job says so. For clean quads with edge loops, fit the body to MPFB or body-gen's template instead.

fields.label: Shape CFG
fields.help: 3.5 gave the cleanest pelvis in the Nora tests.

fields.label: Remove loose bits
fields.help: Strands and flakes smaller than 2 % of the body.

fields.label: Remesh voxel (m)
fields.help: Fine voxels keep ears and fingers (1/140 lost the frost sister's ear).

fields.label: Texture
fields.help: UltraTex paints views around the model from the front reference and bakes them into the UV map (the planes in the preview).

fields.label: Mirror the face
fields.help: Copies the better half of the face to the other side. Needs a symmetric pose. On for base bodies, off by default when you pick a custom outfit (clothes and gear may be asymmetric).

fields.label: Checkpoint
fields.help: Our own UltraTex 4B LoRA. Step 8000 is the tested one.

fields.label: Extra view rings
fields.help: The six base views (front, sides, back, top, bottom) always run. Each ring adds four views at the given angles (0 = front, 90 = right side; elevation > 0 is from above).

fields.label: Extra rings' views
fields.help: Each ring also renders a top and bottom view; dropping them fixed blotchy shoulders and crown.

fields.label: Best-view mix (one bake each)
fields.help: 0 = smooth blend of views, 1 = sharpest view only (more visible seams). Every value gives its own model.

fields.label: Colour gamma
fields.help: 1.3 brightened the UltraTex skin to match the reference. 1 = untouched.
